title: Contabo detects unauthorized access to its systems
content_md:
Contabo detected unauthorized access to its systems. The unauthorized access was detected on Saturday, November 14, 2026. The access was stopped.

Original article: https://linuxiarze.pl/contabo-wykrylo-nieautoryzowany-dostep-do-swoich-systemow/
exclude_reason: Duplicate Polish Contabo post; the English version of the same article is kept.
